source: Bairoch, P., Batou, J., Chevre, P. (1988), La population des villes europeennes 800-1850, Geneva: Droz. Figures in thousands per century, taken here from the manual transcription by Jacob W. Russ (github.com/JakeRuss/bairoch-1988, bairoch-1988.csv), column 1500. Round estimates, not census counts.
note: Bairoch lists a city only when it passes his size threshold; null means not listed for 1500, not zero. Tangier is not in this data bank. These figures are NOT yet used by the game: data/world.json keeps its design numbers until the balance PR. Added 13 more port cities (20 Oct 2026). Malaga 42000 is as transcribed from Bairoch and looks high next to other sources: kept as source figure, not used by the game yet. San Sebastian, Huelva and Ibiza are not listed: null. North Africa (11 ports): Bairoch has no Moroccan or Algerian city for 1500, so all are null, not zero.
